set -e; git diff --check; python3 - <<"PY"
import ast, hashlib, re
from pathlib import Path
repair=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_UNRELATED_MALFORMED_REPAIR_V1/evidence/repair.diff")
print("repair_diff_sha256",hashlib.sha256(repair.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
paths=[]
for line in repair.read_text().splitlines():
    if line.startswith("+++ b/"):
        paths.append(line[6:])
print("repair_paths",paths)
assert set(paths)=={
"src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py",
"tests/trusted_execution/test_known_payment_attempt.py",
"tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py",
}
expected={
"src/agentic_payment_experiment/webshop_runtime_gate.py":"1aa1c3e4ddaaf5f360a75bda2224d83c5b5b6e4b981567795816e62a0600bf93",
"scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py":"a7d71fd92cacd7ebdb8e4a1da383067aa57b0e6dcbf20c41f043f4e461fc1fc4",
"samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json":"f5dc05501c79958b197ea7a727e12660756145da870b897496a9ccac714cacee",
"src/agentic_payment_experiment/__init__.py":"0013d57a92bd2d544d4d811b048ac4bf06ee9277e2d416fa04d2a9e8b87a947f",
"src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/__init__.py":"d64dbc7241b720838cd5c0d37f0fd57b9d393fbfc63193fc6bf00c116d813393",
"tests/test_project_impact_baseline.py":"3e323fe913d67876a2cf2095dd2c257ece4f5d17110da5757abaca59ba25d2b6",
"docs/04_验证体系/项目级能力评测基线_v1.md":"17181fa930954b75e247353cfb66a414c94d60cb9de5d5e7cd3bd64a2778a47f",
}
for p,h in expected.items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(); print(p,actual,actual==h); assert actual==h
source=Path("src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py").read_text()
print("positions",source.index("attempt_request_ref = attempt.request_id"),source.index("if attempt_request_ref != current_request_ref"),source.index("status_is_valid ="),source.index("payment_ref_is_valid ="))
assert source.index("if attempt_request_ref != current_request_ref") < source.index("status_is_valid =") < source.index("payment_ref_is_valid =")
tree=ast.parse(source)
calls=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=="verify_payment_execution_binding"]
print("p2_verifier_call_sites",len(calls)); assert len(calls)==1
for name in ("open","exec","eval","requests","socket","subprocess","system"):
    assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.Call) and ((isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id==name) or (isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr==name)) for n in ast.walk(tree)), name
print("static_audit","PASS")
PY
